text:
maria: Paging SRE — production GPU pool for eu-west-1 is depleted, autoscaler failing to add more nodes. Queue growth started ~10m ago, now seeing request throttling and a lot of 429s. Investigating.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered to oncall-sre (level: P0) — incident created: GPU_POOL_DEPLETION. Link: https://pd.example/INC12345

ashok: I see a sharp increase in queue length in the serving runtime metrics. continuous_batcher.max_batch_window bumped to 500ms in last deploy which looks suspect.

kevin: oncall here, taking it. tagging oncall-ml for model-side suggestions. @lisa can you post the autoscaler logs from the last 30m?

lisa: autoscaler logs (most recent failures):
```
2026-03-14T12:10:02Z WARN autoscaler: scale_attempt failed: quota_limit_reached (16/16)
2026-03-14T12:14:17Z ERROR ServeLoop: pool exhausted, queue_len=1243, throttle=1.0, scale_attempts=3/3
2026-03-14T12:16:44Z ERROR batching: prefix_cache_miss_rate=0.78, kb_cache_eviction=high
```

maria: Customer-facing impacts: streaming generation timeouts and 429s for high-concurrency customers. Early analysis: continuous batching change increased per-request memory, causing pods to hit GPU memory ceiling and autoscaler to hit the tenant-level pool cap.

oncall-ml: Quick mitigation ideas: reduce continuous_batcher.max_batch_window, cap max_batch_size, or temporarily route heavy customers to smaller model variant.

kevin: Let's do a rapid mitigation plan:
1) Lower continuous batching window and max_batch_size to reduce memory per replica.
2) Temporarily increase pool cap for this account if allowed (we hit a soft cap).
3) Clear prefix cache to avoid pathological cache miss amplification.
4) If needed, fall back heavy tenants to cpu-backed dedicated route.

ashok: I'm going to push a hotfix to serving config to revert the recent batching param change (rollback to previous commit). Applying now.

maria: Command for rollback (watch the canary):
```
redwoodctl rollout serve-config --env=prod --service=gpu-serving --from-revision=rev-20260313 --wait
kubectl rollout status ds/gpu-serving -n prod
```

lisa: Also patching autoscaler to ignore transient memory spike metric for 5m to avoid repeated scale attempts. Applying patch: `autoscaler.tolerances.memory_spike_window=300s`

kevin: I'm requesting a temporary pool cap increase with infra: `infra-request increase-gpu-pool --region eu-west-1 --add=8` — pinging infra oncall.

incident-bot: infra oncall paged. ETA ~8-12m for capacity change.

maria: While we wait, reduce continuous batching client-side:
```
# change in config store
continuous_batcher:
  max_batch_window_ms: 80
  max_batch_tokens: 512
```

ashok: Done. Pushed and canaryed to 10% traffic. Early telemetry shows queue_len dropping from 1200 -> 430 in canary.

lisa: infra replied — pool cap adjusted +8 GPUs, autoscaler now can provision up to 24. Starting scale up.

kevin: Monitoring live: new nodes joining, memory pressure easing. Throttles dropping, 429 rate down 72% in 5m. Marking mitigation in progress.

maria: Quick customer impact summary for comms team: Affected customers ~4 high-concurrency tenants, estimated 15-30% of their requests hit 429 between 12:05-12:30 UTC, most requests restored by 12:40 after mitigation. I'll draft a brief.

lisa: Important note — prefix cache miss rate spiked because a recent change to prefix-cache eviction policy meant keys were not promoted correctly; that's causing ineffective KV caching and extra workload on batcher. Filed PR to revert: PR#4567.

oncall-ml: For postmortem: root cause probable chain: batching param regression -> increased per-pod memory -> pods hit memory ceiling -> autoscaler hit pool cap -> queue growth & throttling. Secondary: prefix-cache eviction tweak amplified load.

kevin: Assigning postmortem owner: maria. Timeline, impact numbers, and remediation plan due EOD tomorrow.

maria: Acknowledged. Action items:
- maria: write postmortem and customer-impact note.
- ashok: revert batching param change and bake tests to catch mem regression.
- lisa: revert prefix-cache eviction change and add canary for miss_rate.
- kevin: follow up with infra on quota/process to avoid soft-cap surprises.

incident-bot: Incident state changed to: mitigated. Incident lead: kevin. Next step: run full regression test and schedule retrospective.

kevin: Closing thread on live mitigation. Will keep monitoring for 2h and reopen if any regressions. Thanks everyone for fast responses. :thumbsup:

maria: Postmortem draft will include proposed long-term fixes: autoscaler safety valve to auto-shift heavy tenants, model-variant routing for burst capacity, stricter gating on batching/config change, and additional observability for prefix cache metrics.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 acknowledged by kevin at 2026-03-14T12:44:55Z.

lisa: Leaving a note to ops: add an automated check that flags if continuous_batcher changes increase per-replica GPU memory by >10% in canary.

maria: Thanks everyone. Closing thread but will post the postmortem link here when ready.
